steps.what: Manage client travel, ticketing and marketing arrangements and resolve exceptions

tasks.design: Retain negotiation, coordination and exception resolution with the business manager. Existing commitments in {CRM} and supplier correspondence in {EMAIL} support the work without a new automation claim.
tasks.previous_blocker: Client preferences and supplier constraints change case by case.
tasks.enabler_now: No specific repeated clerical component is established for this broad management task.
tasks.still_hard: Reconcile travel, sales and promotion commitments when plans change.
tasks.human_edge: Represent the client's priorities in consequential conversations.
tasks.altitude: Management time and delegated authority stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Managing heterogeneous client affairs requires relationship work; no generic clerical baseline is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is the manager's coordination, excluding suppliers' execution and separate accounting statements.
The manager elicits priorities and verifies offers during s1; no free structured availability, budget permission or campaign status is assumed.
Inspect native booking and relationship-system features before custom work; no added system is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no changed workflow is introduced.
unknowns: Mix of arrangements, existing tools and client mandate

tasks.design: Keep coach selection and agreement with the manager and client. {DOCS} can hold proposals and references without assigning an automated suitability score.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coaching fit depends on trust and the client's performance needs.
tasks.enabler_now: No supplied capability replaces that selection conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Verify relevant experience and fit rather than relying on a polished proposal.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a mismatch and negotiate appropriate terms.
tasks.altitude: Hiring time and mandate remain unchanged.

steps.what: Verify accounting records, period, client allocation and statement rules
Prepare periodic accounting statements from verified client transactions
Reconcile the statement, resolve discrepancies and accept the exact final version

tasks.design: Configure a client statement in {ERP} from verified transaction and agreement fields. Retain capture checks and reconciliation, saving the accepted version in {DOCS}; external sending is outside this preparation task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Transactions and client-specific agreement rules are assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reporting can apply explicit grouping and approved calculation rules.
tasks.still_hard: Disputed expenses, allocation, cutoffs and agreement interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Identify an unsupported charge before it reaches the client.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive statement assembly; financial responsibility remains.

evidence.claim: Native financial reports can assemble statements from verified transaction and rule fields; this deployment and saving are model-knowledge assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is statement preparation ending at internal acceptance; sending, advice, source bookkeeping and payment remain separate.

Bookkeepers produce transaction identifier, client code, date, amount, currency, account, posting status and source reference in existing bookkeeping work. In s1 the manager captures period and verifies allocation, opening balance, receipts, costs and explicit commission rules from signed agreements; full manual extraction and clarification time stays in the 35 percent.
No free interpreted contract fields are assumed: unclear rules or missing postings stop generation until manually resolved. Additional rule and mapping support is counted as other-role upkeep.
Test native client statements before custom code; already automatic assembly earns no new saving.
unknowns: Ledger quality and current statement automation
research_questions: Can native statements reduce preparation time after agreement extraction and reconciliation?

already_counted.description: Input capture, agreement checks and statement reconciliation

incremental.description: Rule maintenance and sampled statement checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact client, period, ledger snapshot, commission rules and statement totals; edits void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R60 gross40 minus7 upkeep gives net33. Range0-8 allows existing native reports or substantial contract-rule clarification to absorb most assembly opportunity.

tasks.human_edge: Explain tradeoffs and seek specialist input when necessary.

evidence.claim: Personal financial and legal advice requires contextual professional judgement; no automated recommendation is proposed.

The manager elicits and verifies client circumstances during s1; no free structured suitability, legal conclusion or tax status is assumed.
Existing record access suffices; no custom answer system is proposed.
Zero upkeep because this design adds no tooling or process.
